decks.notes: The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's plays and utilizing the Phyrexian Dreadnought's ability to quickly put a large creature on the battlefield. It includes cards like Swords to Plowshares, Force of Will, and Stifle to disrupt the opponent's strategy while using Ponder and Brainstorm for card selection and advantage. The combination of control elements and the powerful Dreadnought creates a unique and effective strategy for dominating the game. Additionally, cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Prismatic Ending provide additional versatility and options for dealing with different threats.

This deck focuses on controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's game plan while also applying pressure with efficient threats. By utilizing disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will, as well as tempo plays with cards like Daze and Brazen Borrower, the deck aims to keep the opponent on the back foot while establishing a strong board presence with creatures like Nethergoyf and Murktide Regent. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps to generate card advantage and further disrupt the opponent's plans, while also providing a win condition if left unchecked.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling combo pieces to reanimate powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Griselbrand. It utilizes cards like Unmask, Thoughtseize, and Cabal Therapy to disrupt the opponent's game plan while efficiently filling the graveyard with key targets. The deck also includes cards like Reanimate, Animate Dead, and Shallow Grave to bring back creatures from the graveyard for a powerful swing in momentum. Overall, the strategy is to quickly and efficiently bring back high-impact creatures to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly getting powerful creatures onto the battlefield through the use of Show and Tell or Sneak Attack. Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Emrakul, the Aeons Torn can be put into play for free, overwhelming the opponent with their strength. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect the combo pieces. The goal is to establish a dominant board presence and win the game before the opponent can respond effectively.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble and utilize the combo involving Mystic Forge, Urza's Tower, and several artifact cards to generate powerful mana and card advantage. This allows the player to quickly cast high-cost cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, Eye of the Storms to control the board and win the game. The deck also includes support cards like Pithing Needle and Glaring Fleshraker to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana and overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats.

The deck focuses on quickly getting out the powerful combo of Show and Tell, Omniscience, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier or Emrakul, the Aeons Torn. The goal is to cheat out these high-cost creatures onto the battlefield without paying their mana cost, utilizing cards like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Force of Will to draw and protect the combo pieces. The deck also includes disruption with Veil of Summer and proactive ramp with Lotus Petal and Ancient Tomb to accelerate the combo. The key strategy is to overwhelm opponents with powerful, game-ending threats early in the game.

This deck focuses on assembling the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's library. It uses cards like Goblin Engineer and Goblin Welder to find and recur key pieces, while also utilizing Urza's Saga to search for artifacts. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Pyroblast and Red Elemental Blast, as well as removal in Lightning Bolt. The goal is to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up the combo win condition.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently bring powerful creatures, such as Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, from the graveyard back onto the battlefield using reanimation spells like Reanimate, Animate Dead, and Shallow Grave. Cards like Faithless Looting and Collective Brutality help to fill the graveyard with targets for these spells while disruption cards like Cabal Therapy and Thoughtseize can help to disrupt an opponent's strategy. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large, impactful creatures while also disrupting their game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the necessary combo pieces to generate a large amount of mana and cast Necrodominance, allowing for a powerful win condition such as Tendrils of Agony or Valakut Awakening. It utilizes fast mana acceleration like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide, along with rituals like Dark Ritual and Cabal Ritual, to quickly ramp up to the combo. The deck also includes protection in the form of Pact of Negation and Beseech the Mirror to ensure the combo goes off successfully.

The deck focuses on utilizing cheap spells and efficient creatures to maintain tempo and pressure the opponent. By combining disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will with aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, the deck aims to control the game while dealing consistent damage. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, with fetch lands and dual lands to ensure the correct colors are available. The inclusion of card draw and selection spells such as Brainstorm and Ponder further enhances the deck's ability to maintain its aggressive game plan.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Voice of Victory, Amped Raptor, and Ocelot Pride to pressure the opponent while controlling the board with cards like Wasteland and Static Prison. The deck also includes interaction and removal spells such as Swords to Plowshares to maintain board presence. Additionally, the inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional mana acceleration and flexibility. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient aggro strategy while disrupting their game plan.

The main concept of the deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with cards such as Stitcher's Supplier and Gravecrawler in order to set up for powerful plays with Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis and Reanimate. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Cabal Therapy and Thoughtseize while also utilizing cards like Once Upon a Time to find important pieces. The deck also includes a sacrifice outlet in Carrion Feeder and protection in Sylvan Safekeeper to ensure that the combo can go off smoothly.

Utilizing a combination of land destruction, land recursion, and control elements, this Legacy deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's mana base while assembling a powerful combo of Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 indestructible creature. The deck also includes resilient lands like The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale and Boseiju, Who Endures to protect key pieces and disrupt the opponent's spells. By controlling the game through land manipulation and efficient spells, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in a slow and methodical manner.

The focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing lands to disrupt the opponent's strategy while also accelerating your own game plan. The deck employs cards like Wasteland and Ghost Quarter to disrupt the opponent's mana base, while using Life from the Loam to recur lands and maintain resources. Urza's Saga and Thespian's Stage provide additional utility and threats, while the combination of Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage can quickly create a powerful 20/20 token. Exploration and Mox Diamond help ramp up the mana base, allowing for explosive plays and early threats.

The main concept of this Aluren Combo deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces, such as Aluren and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, to generate infinite value and overwhelm the opponent. Utilizing cards like Show and Tell and Omniscience can help to cheat out expensive creatures like Acererak the Archlich. The deck focuses on creating a powerful board presence and leveraging the Aluren combo to outvalue and outpace the opponent, ultimately leading to a swift victory through card advantage and overwhelming board presence.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy through a combination of counter spells, removal spells, and land destruction. The deck focuses on utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Tamiyo and Teferi, along with cards like Quantum Riddler and Stifle, to manipulate the game and gain incremental advantages. Additionally, the deck includes Phelia, a strong creature that can generate value over time. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent and grind out a win through resource management and strategic plays.
